fields.summary_ko.0: Visa Inc. (V) is a company that operates payment technology business in the United States and internationally, providing the VisaNet transaction processing network and credit, debit, prepaid card products, tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services.
fields.summary_ko.1: Through the Visa Direct platform, it facilitates fund movement and maintains a broad portfolio including acceptance solutions, risk detection and prevention solutions, and advisory and management services.
